_comment: Fleet session-worktree GC (scripts/worktree_gc.py). armed:false = report-only; deletion refuses. Flipping armed to true is the operator's ratification act — see research/WORKTREE_GC_POLICY.md before arming. JSON (not yml) so the tool runs on a bare system python3 under launchd with no pyyaml. The in-repo `.codex/worktrees` and the home-dir `~/.codex/worktrees` are DIFFERENT roots, not a duplicate — the in-repo one (55 checkouts) was missing until 2026-08-11. Registered worktrees are CLASSIFIED from `git worktree list` regardless of this list, so the miss was invisible in the report; what a missing root actually breaks is deletion (the final belt refuses any target `outside configured roots`, so a SAFE verdict there can never be acted on) and `scan_orphans`, which only walks configured in-repo roots. The four in-repo roots must stay in step with `.gitignore` and `ship_loop_guard.AGENT_WORKTREE_ROOTS`; `tests/test_agent_worktree_roots.py` pins them.
